pr_title: [Https] Fix for issue getting private key after having previously exported it
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/21733

The fix here is to cache the results for each certificate we check for exportable keys the first time so as to avoid running into the issue mentioned in .NET Core.

This is a workaround for an underlying runtime issue, which will be fixed in .NET 5.0: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/36273

issue_context.title: [Https] Issue when getting private key after being exported
issue_context.body:
When running the `dotnet-dev-certs` tool with the `--trust and --export-path --password` options simultaneously, we try to access the private key after the certificate has been exported.

This causes an underlying issue in .NET Core that causes the key to become unusable in future operations, which in turn causes a failure the next time we try to check for a valid certificate so we decide to generate a new one.

Repeating the problem over and over.

The fix will ultimately come from fixing the logic in .NET Core, but in the mean time, we can change our usage in the tool to avoid running into this specific issue.
